63075-coco-bolo-king-of-the-floating-isl.title: Coco Bolo King Of The Floating Islands
63075-coco-bolo-king-of-the-floating-isl.creator: Unknown
63075-coco-bolo-king-of-the-floating-isl.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. They had been spending the winter on the coast of Southern California, when, one morning in April, Margaret and Frances went out into the road in front of the house, and turning their backs to the sun, amused themselves by running after their shadows, trying to step on their own heads--a feat they had often attempted before, but never yet with any success.

arxiv-2011-09097.title: The propagation and transformation of light beam on curved surface
arxiv-2011-09097.creator: ZIQIU SHAO, ZHAOYING WANG
arxiv-2011-09097.description: Abstract Starting from the wave function with abstract index notations, with the help of Wentzel–Kramers–Brillouin (WKB) approximation, a generalized coordinate-independent expression for the evolution of light beam on curved space is derived. By defining the propagation axes, the expression reduces to integrable Green functions.

arxiv-2307-03875.title: Large Language Models for Supply Chain Optimization
arxiv-2307-03875.creator: Beibin Li, Konstantina Mellou, Bo Zhang, Jeevan Pathuri, Ishai Menache
arxiv-2307-03875.description: Abstract Supply chain operations traditionally involve a variety of complex decision making problems. Over the last few decades, supply chains greatly benefited from advances in computation, which allowed the transition from manual processing to automation and cost-effective optimization. Nonetheless, business operators still need to spend substantial efforts in explaining and interpreting the optimization outcomes to stakeholders.

arxiv-2312-01721.title: The Self-Loop Paradox: Investigating the Impact of Self-Loops on Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2312-01721.creator: Moritz Lampert, Ingo Scholtes
arxiv-2312-01721.description: Abstract Many Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) add self-loops to a graph to include feature information about a node itself at each layer. However, if the GNN consists of more than one layer, this information can return to its origin via cycles in the graph topology.

arxiv-2405-14654.title: Efficient Medical Question Answering with Knowledge-Augmented Question Generation
arxiv-2405-14654.creator: Julien Khlaut, Corentin Dancette, Elodie Ferreres, Alaedine Bennani, Paul Hérent, Pierre Manceron
arxiv-2405-14654.description: Abstract In the expanding field of language model applications, medical knowledge representation remains a significant challenge due to the specialized nature of the domain. Large language models, such as GPT-4 OpenAI (2023) , obtain reasonable scores on medical question answering tasks, but smaller models are far behind.

arxiv-2412-03023.title: A Multi-Functional Web Tool for Comprehensive Threat Detection Through IP Address Analysis
arxiv-2412-03023.creator: Cebajel Tanan, Sameer G. Kulkarni, Tamal Das, Manjesh K. Hanawal
arxiv-2412-03023.description: Abstract In recent years, the advances in digitalisation have also adversely contributed to the significant rise in cybercrimes. Hence, building the threat intelligence to shield against rising cybercrimes has become a fundamental requisite. Internet Protocol (IP) addresses play a crucial role in the threat intelligence and prevention of cyber crimes.

arxiv-2506-00899.title: A data model to connect the ESO Data Processing System (EDPS) to ELT data archives
arxiv-2506-00899.creator: Hugo Buddelmeijer, Gijs Verdoes Kleijn
arxiv-2506-00899.description: Abstract We extend the data-driven approach for astronomical pipelines to the METIS instrument and integrate the ESO Data Processing System (EDPS) by adapting it to support backward chaining. 1 Kapteyn Astronomical Institute, University of Groningen, 9747 AD, Groningen, The Netherlands; buddel@astro.rug.

arxiv-2506-10087.title: Wave-front tracking for a quasi-linear scalar conservation law with hysteresis II: the case of Preisach
arxiv-2506-10087.creator: Fabio Bagagiolo, Stefan Moreti
arxiv-2506-10087.description: Abstract We consider the Cauchy problem for the quasi-linear scalar conservation law u t + ℱ ​ ( u ) t + u x = 0 , u_{t}+\mathcal{F}(u)_{t}+u_{x}=0, where ℱ \mathcal{F} is a specific hysteresis operator. Hysteresis models a rate-independent memory relationship between the input u u and its output, giving a non-local feature to the equation.

Early secretory antigenic target-6 (ESAT-6) and culture filtrate protein-10 (CFP-10) are co-secreted proteins of Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex mycobacteria (includes M. bovis , the zoonotic agent of bovine tuberculosis) involved in phagolysosome escape of the bacillus and, p

pmc-10529902.title: Novel Modified Styrene-Based Microspheres for Enhancing the Performance of Drilling Fluids at High Temperatures
pmc-10529902.creator: Xianfa Zhang, Jingping Liu, Jinsheng Sun, Kaihe Lv, Zonglun Wang, Zhe Xu, Yuanwei Sun, Clemens K Weiss
pmc-10529902.description: Ensuring wellbore stability is of utmost importance for safety when drilling in deep formations. However, high temperatures severely disrupt the drilling fluid gel system, leading to severe stability issues within ultra-deep formations containing micropores. This study focused on the development of a polymer-based plugging material capable of withstanding high temperatures up to 200 °C.

pmc-10674462.title: Second-Generation Polyamidoamine Dendrimer Conjugated with Oligopeptides Can Enhance Plasmid DNA Delivery In Vitro
pmc-10674462.creator: Seongyeon Kim, Le Thi Thuy, Jeil Lee, Joon Sig Choi
pmc-10674462.description: Poly(amidoamine) (PAMAM) dendrimers have attracted considerable attention in the field of gene therapy due to their flexibility in introducing different functional moieties and reduced toxicity at low generations. However, their transfection efficiency remains a limitation. Therefore, an essential approach for improving their transfection efficiency as gene carriers involves modifying the structure of PAMAM by conjugating functional groups around their surface.

pmc-11340773.title: Secreted factors from M1 macrophages drive prostate cancer stem cell plasticity by upregulating NANOG, SOX2, and CD44 through NFκB-signaling
pmc-11340773.creator: Kirsi Kainulainen, Einari A Niskanen, Johanna Kinnunen, Kaisa Mäki-Mantila, Kiia Hartikainen, Ville Paakinaho, Marjo Malinen, Kirsi Ketola, Sanna Pasonen-Seppänen
pmc-11340773.description: The inflammatory tumor microenvironment (TME) is a key driver for tumor-promoting processes. Tumor-associated macrophages are one of the main immune cell types in the TME and their increased density is related to poor prognosis in prostate cancer. Here, we investigated the influence of pro-inflammatory (M1) and immunosuppressive (M2) macrophages on prostate cancer lineage plasticity.

pmc-11928302.title: The life quality of people living with chronic disease in Africa: a systematic narrative synthesis
pmc-11928302.creator: Badre Bakzaza, Hanane Lemmih, Faouzi Errachidi, Omaima El Bouazzi, Saad Rachiq, Sidi Mohammed Raoui
pmc-11928302.description: Nowadays, chronic diseases are more common and affect a huge number of individuals. They can have a negative impact on the quality of life in many domains, including physical well-being, mental health and social relationships. This systematic narrative synthesis aims to explore health-related quality of life in people with chronic diseases in Africa.

pmc-12386949.title: Clonal Dissemination of Pandrug-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae ST392KL27 in a Tertiary Care Hospital in Mexico
pmc-12386949.creator: Iliana Alejandra Cortés-Ortíz, Enoc Mariano Cortés-Malagón, Eduardo García-Moncada, Gustavo Acosta-Altamirano, Jesús Alejandro Pineda-Migranas, Karen Lizzet García-Prudencio, Edgar Mendieta-Condado, Adnan Araiza-Rodríguez, Alejandra Yareth Bonilla-Cortés, Mónica Sierra-Martínez, Juan Carlos Bravata-
pmc-12386949.description: The global emergence of multidrug- and pandrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae poses a critical threat to public health, particularly in hospital settings. This study describes a nosocomial outbreak caused by K. pneumoniae in a tertiary-care hospital in Mexico and provides a comprehensive genomic analysis of six clinical isolates. All isolates exhibited pandrug resistance, including carbapenems and colistin.

pmc-12591734.title: Acute stroke diagnosis: diagnostic efficacy of dual-layer spectral computed tomography for non-contrast ischemic sign detection
pmc-12591734.creator: Yujie Wang, Weiping Wu, Weifang Liu, Shan Yang, Jun Qin, Bin Liu, Haifeng Zhu
pmc-12591734.description: BackgroundNon-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) is a common imaging technique for suspected acute ischemic stroke (AIS); however, early ischemic changes (EICs) in AIS patients often present with subtle differences on NCCT. Dual-layer spectral computed tomography (DLCT) can reduce artifacts and provide more accurate tissue characterization. This study aimed to assess the effectiveness of DLCT in detecting EICs in AIS patients.

pmc-12645226.title: COVID‐19 Infection Before or After Colorectal Cancer Diagnosis Is an Independent Predictor of Mortality and Treatment Delays Compared to Patients Who Never Tested Positive
pmc-12645226.creator: Imran Qureshi, Steven Rella, Aasma Shaukat
pmc-12645226.description: BackgroundGiven COVID‐19's emergence as a new entity and colorectal cancer's (CRC) rising incidence in certain populations, we conducted this retrospective cohort study to determine the link between COVID‐19 and the mortality of those with CRC and how socioeconomic factors influence it.

pmc-13038001.title: Predicted antiviral potential of phytochemicals prolific in Cleistanthus bracteosus Jabl. and essential oils of Artemisia scoparia and Thuja orientalis against Nipah virus and Human metapneumovirus: An AI-driven in-silico study
pmc-13038001.creator: Mackingsley Kushan Dassanayake, Teng-Jin Khoo, Chien Hwa Chong, Mohammed Tahir Ansari, Patrick Di Martino, Fernando Berton Zanchi, Adam Figiel, Antoni Szumny, Omar Ashraf Elfar, Christophe Wiart, Rachael Symonds, Mozaniel de Oliveira, Mozaniel de Oliveira, Mozaniel de Oliveira, Mozaniel de Oliveira,
pmc-13038001.description: The recent Nipah virus (NiV) epidemic and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) outbreak have had a significant impact on human health and society worldwide. The attachment glycoprotein (G) and fusion glycoprotein (F0) of NiV and hMPV are essential for pathogenesis and are potentially pronounced targets for antiviral treatment.

pmc-13101190.title: mTORC1 as a metabolic rheostat coordinates hormonal signals and cellular proliferation to sustain endometrial competence
pmc-13101190.creator: Yadong Sun, Shuo Wan, Mingyue Zhao, Kexin Chen, Yue Wu, Yong Huang, Jun He, Feng Liu, Hanlin Shuai, Jiacong Yan, Meixiang Yang
pmc-13101190.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOptimal endometrial thickness and receptivity, precisely regulated by steroid hormones, are critical determinants for successful embryo implantation. Thin endometrium is a major cause of female infertility, yet its pathogenesis requires further exploration. Cellular proliferation and differentiation are highly dependent on the activation status of intracellular metabolic signaling pathways, among which the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) signaling pathway serves as a central metabolic integrator.

pmc-13264987.title: Advances in Tetrahedral Framework Nucleic Acids (tFNAs) for Lung Injury Repair: Mechanisms, Therapeutic Applications, and Future Directions
pmc-13264987.creator: Jipeng Song, Xin Chen, Quanjie Hou, Pan Zhao, Xianpeng Zu

pmc-13502393.title: Disclosing Trends on C(1s) Core-Level Binding Energies of MXene Flakes: Metal, Size and Edge Effects
pmc-13502393.creator: Miquel Allés, Sergi Vela, Carmen Sousa, Francesc Illas
pmc-13502393.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The C­(1s) core-level binding energies (CLBE) of realistic MXene finite systems were investigated using density functional theory (DFT). The ΔSCF approach was employed to explicitly account for final state effects. MXene flakes with M2CT x stoichiometry (M = Sc, Y, Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb, and Ta, where T x denotes surface termination), consisting of 18 stoichiometric units, were constructed in both pristine (M2C)18 and O-functionalized (M2CO2)18 forms.

Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) A claimant may appeal the final denial of the claim.
